lines: Hazaaron khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle
couplets.en: A thousand longings, each enough to draw my last breath.

lines: Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
couplets.en: So many of my desires were fulfilled, and still too few.

lines: Nikalna khuld se Aadam ka sunte aaye hain lekin
Bahut be-aabru ho kar tere kooche se hum nikle
couplets.en: We have long heard how Adam left paradise, but I left your lane in utter disgrace.

lines: Mohabbat mein nahin hai farq jeene aur marne ka
couplets.en: In love, there is no difference between living and dying.

lines: Usi ko dekh kar jeete hain jis kaafir pe dam nikle
couplets.en: The sight of that faithless one keeps me alive, and for that same one I would draw my last breath.

lines: Hazaaron khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle
Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
couplets.en: A thousand longings, each enough to draw my last breath, and though so many were fulfilled, they were still too few.

lines: Khuda ke waaste parda na Kaabe se utha zaalim
couplets.en: For God's sake, cruel one, leave the veil upon the Kaaba.

lines: Khuda ke waaste parda na Kaabe se utha zaalim
Kahin aisa na ho yaan bhi wahi kaafir sanam nikle
couplets.en: For God's sake, cruel one, leave the veil upon the Kaaba, lest that same faithless idol be there too.

lines: Kahaan maikhaane ka darwaaza Ghalib aur kahaan waaiz
couplets.en: What business has the preacher at the tavern door, Ghalib?

lines: Par itna jaante hain kal woh jaata tha ke hum nikle
couplets.en: All I know is that yesterday he was heading in as I came out.

lines: Hazaaron khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle
